exams.name: Public Adjuster Examination
exams.notes: Written examination testing knowledge of duties and responsibilities of a public adjuster and insurance laws and regulations of Illinois. Exemptions available for previously licensed adjusters.
exams.jurisdiction: state (administered under rules prescribed by the Director, may contract with outside testing service)
exams.quote: An individual applying for a public adjuster license under this Article must pass a written examination unless he or she is exempt pursuant to Section 1535 of this Article.

required.quote: An individual who holds a public adjuster license and who is not exempt under subsection (b) of this Section shall satisfactorily complete a minimum of 24 hours of continuing education courses, including 3 hours of classroom or webinar ethics instruction, reported on a biennial basis in conjunction with the license renewal cycle.

available.quote: Unless denied licensure pursuant to Section 1555 of this Article, a nonresident person shall receive a nonresident public adjuster license if: (1) the person is currently licensed as a resident public adjuster and in good standing in his or her home state;

requirements.value: Nonresident must be currently licensed as a resident public adjuster in good standing in home state, submit proper application, provide proof of financial responsibility, and home state must award nonresident licenses to Illinois residents on the same basis.
requirements.quote: the person's home state awards nonresident public adjuster licenses to residents of this State on the same basis.

bonding_required.quote: Prior to the issuance of a license as a public adjuster and for the duration of the license, the applicant shall secure evidence of financial responsibility in a format prescribed by the Director through a surety bond or irrevocable letter of credit

definition_quote.value: Public adjuster means any person who, for compensation or any other thing of value on behalf of the insured: (i) acts, aids, or represents the insured solely in relation to first party claims arising under insurance contracts that insure the real or personal property of the insured, in adjusting a claim for loss or damage covered by an insurance contract; (ii) advertises for employment as a public adjuster of insurance claims or solicits business or represents himself or herself to the public as a public adjuster of first party insurance claims for losses or damages arising out of policies of insurance that insure real or personal property; or (iii) directly or indirectly solicits business, investigates or adjusts losses, or advises an insured about first party claims for losses or damages arising out of policies of insurance that insure real or personal property for another person engaged in the business of adjusting losses or damages covered by an insurance policy for the insured.
definition_quote.quote: "Public adjuster" means any person who, for compensation or any other thing of value on behalf of the insured: (i) acts, aids, or represents the insured solely in relation to first party claims arising under insurance contracts that insure the real or personal property of the insured, in adjusting a claim for loss or damage covered by an insurance contract

business_entity_licensure_allowed.quote: A business entity acting as a public adjuster is required to obtain a public adjuster license.

designated_licensee_required_for_busines.quote: all officers, shareholders, and persons with ownership interests in the business entity are licensed public adjusters responsible for the business entity's compliance with the insurance laws, rules, and regulations of this State.

resident_vs_nonresident_license_types.quote: Unless denied licensure pursuant to Section 1555 of this Article, a nonresident person shall receive a nonresident public adjuster license

fingerprint_background_check_required.quote: the Director is authorized to require all applicants for licensing, including renewal applicants, to undergo a fingerprint-based criminal history record check for the first year following the effective date of this amendatory Act of the 97th General Assembly. The fingerprints and the fee required to perform the criminal history record checks shall be submitted to the Illinois State Police and the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) to conduct a State and national criminal history record check.

prohibited_salvage_business_interest.quote: A public adjuster shall not acquire any interest in the salvage of property subject to the contract with the insured unless the public adjuster obtains written permission from the insured after settlement of the claim with the insurer

surety_bond_required.quote: Prior to the issuance of a license as a public adjuster and for the duration of the license, the applicant shall secure evidence of financial responsibility in a format prescribed by the Director through a surety bond or irrevocable letter of credit

surety_bond_minimum_amount.quote: shall be in the minimum amount of $50,000;

written_contract_required.quote: A public adjuster shall not provide services, other than emergency services, until a written contract with the insured has been executed, on a form filed with and approved by the Director

contract_rescission_period_days.quote: At the option of the insured, any such contract shall be voidable for 5 business days after the contract is received by the insurer.

insurer_notification_deadline_days.quote: The public adjuster shall provide the insurer or its authorized representative for receiving notice of loss or damage with an exact copy of the contract with the insured by email no later than 5 business days after execution of the contract

financial_interest_disclosure_required.quote: A public adjuster shall provide the insured a written disclosure concerning any direct or indirect financial interest that the public adjuster has with any other party who is involved in any aspect of the claim

prohibited_claim_types.quote: a person who negotiates or settles claims arising under a life or health insurance policy or an annuity contract

claims_only_against_own_insurer.quote: limiting their licensure to assisting insureds in first party claims

repair_contract_prohibition_before_settl.quote: a public adjuster shall not enter into a contract or accept a power of attorney that vests in the public adjuster the effective authority to choose the persons who shall perform repair work;

catastrophe_solicitation_prohibited.quote: A public adjuster may not propose or attempt to propose to any person that the public adjuster represent that person while a loss-producing occurrence is continuing, nor while the fire department or its representatives are engaged at the damaged premises, nor between the hours of 7:00 p.m. and 8:00 a.m.

max_civil_penalty_per_violation.quote: a person may, after hearing, be subject to a civil penalty of up to $10,000 for each cause for denial, suspension, or revocation, however, the civil penalty may total no more than $100,000.
